newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end slightly up, but off highs.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end slightly up, but off highs.

text.p: Swedish shares ended slightly higher on Tuesday after coming off day highs when New York seemed to have lost its recent strength at the opening.
The bourse's general index rose 0.12 percent to 2,737.68 in turnover of 6.18 billion crowns.
"The market lost steam in the afternoon," a trader said. "When you saw...that the U.S. wouldn't surge again there weren't that many buyers any longer."
Heavyweights drugs major Astra and telecoms group Ericsson helped pull indices off highs. Astra fell 5.5 crowns to 319.5 and Ericsson slid 5.5 to 258.5.
The forestry sector kept rising, up 1.83 percent after U.S. gains on Monday and on speculation about a sharp fall in North American and Scandinavian (NorScan) stocks in April.
Insurers Skandia and Trygg-Hansa took different directions after reporting strong first quarter earnings. Skandia edged 0.5 crown higher to 240, while Trygg-Hansa slipped two to 144.
Specialty tool maker Sandvik jumped seven to 210 crowns after releasing its first quarter report and tobacco group Swedish Match rose 0.9 crown to 27.2 after showing first quarter figures.
